literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 系统发育分析显示,DENV-1和DENV-2多种基因型同时共循环。DENV-1分离株主要为基因型I(86%)和基因型IV(14%),而DENV-2分离株主要为宇宙型基因型(98%)。两种基因型均与之前报道的越南及东南亚地区分离株聚类,表明病毒在当地持续传播并存在区域间的病毒交换。 [10.1186/s41182-026-01092-5]
研究发现,沉默CLK1增强了免疫应答基因的诱导,而其过表达则抑制了这种诱导。此外,使用TG003抑制CLK1激酶活性进一步增强了干扰素诱导的基因表达,并减少了登革病毒的复制。 [10.1042/bcj20260367]
T1时,61%的接种儿童为应答者。在第一随访期(基线-T1)内,疫苗接种与WT DENV感染风险降低相关(疫苗疗效[VE]=45%)。低水平YFV NS1应答在T2仍可检测到。 [10.3389/fimmu.2026.1959704]
2023年、2024年和2025年,原发性登革热病例分别占75.9%、80.4%和71.4%。在发病后前5天内,RDT对原发性和继发性登革热的敏感性分别为93.3%和94.7%。DENV-1、DENV-2和DENV-3分别占病例的47.0%、5.6%和47.4%。未检测到DENV-4。RDT对原发性和继发性登革热的诊断特异性均为100%。 [10.1007/s10096-026-05693-0]
本研究揭示了在ZIKV感染期间存在两种NS2A异构体,包括全长NS2A和一个C端截断的异构体,称为NS2Aα。 [10.1371/journal.ppat.1014609]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。

key_findings_en: Phylogenetic analysis revealed the co-circulation of diverse DENV-1 and DENV-2 genotypes. DENV-1 isolates were predominantly genotype I (86%) and genotype IV (14%), while DENV-2 isolates were predominantly the Cosmopolitan genotype (98%). [10.1186/s41182-026-01092-5]

The study found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its over-expression attenuated it. Additionally, inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. [10.1042/bcj20260367]

At T1, 61% of vaccinated children were responders. During the first follow-up period (baseline-T1), vaccination was associated with a reduced risk of WT DENV infection (vaccine effectiveness [VE]=45%). Low-level YFV NS1 responses remained detectable through T2. [10.3389/fimmu.2026.1959704]

Primary dengue accounted for 75.9%, 80.4%, and 71.4% in 2023, 2024, and 2025, respectively. The sensitivity of the RDT for determining primary and post-primary dengue during the first 5 days of illness was 93.3% and 94.7%, respectively. [10.1007/s10096-026-05693-0]
The study revealed that two NS2A isoforms are present during ZIKV infection, including both full-length NS2A and a C-terminally truncated isoform, termed NS2Aα. [10.1371/journal.ppat.1014609]

key_findings_zh: 佛罗里达州报告了一起登革热暴发事件,讨论了症状、检测、治疗及预防措施。该事件被描述为一般性概述,而非确认的暴发。 [news-0a250c00f8888624]

2026年佛罗里达州经历了登革热暴发,第39周更新报告了296例本地感染病例和1例确认死亡。该事件由佛罗里达州卫生部报告。 [news-f3ff4693bb275735]

papers.title: Heterogeneous co-circulation of multiple DENV-1 and DENV-2 genotypes in Vung Tau during the 2023 dengue outbreak in Vietnam
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) remains a significant global health threat, particularly in hyper-endemic regions like Vietnam, where the co-circulation of multiple serotypes and genotypes complicates disease control. In 2023, 6.5 million dengue cases and 6,800 deaths were reported globally, marking the largest dengue outbreak in the world. Vietnam recorded 149,557 dengue cases and 36 deaths, with a notable dominance of the DENV-2 serotype. This study provides a comprehensive genomic characterization of the 2023 outbreak using isolates collected from hospitalized patients (n = 148; 66.89% adults). To ensure robust viral recovery, we propagated 90 isolates using a low-passage, antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE)-based system. Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) of 53 isolates yielded 47 consensus sequences, including 26 complete genomes. Phylogenetic analysis revealed the simultaneous co-circulation of diverse DENV-1 and DENV-2 genotypes. DENV-1 isolates were predominantly genotype I (86%), clustering closely with prior Vietnamese strains and suggesting sustained endemic maintenance, while genotype IV (14%) was detected sporadically. Among DENV-2 isolates, the Cosmopolitan genotype was predominant (98%), with a smaller proportion (2%) belonging to the Asian 1 genotype. Both genotypes clustered with previously reported Vietnamese and regional Southeast Asian strains, indicating ongoing local circulation and regional viral exchange. Comparative mutational analysis of DENV-2 Cosmopolitan isolates identified multiple non-synonymous amino acid substitutions across the viral genome. Fourteen substitutions were shared between Vietnamese historical (2019-2022) and 2023 isolates, while 24 substitutions were unique to the 2023 outbreak strains. The majority of amino acid changes were concentrated within the NS5, E, NS1, and NS3 proteins, suggesting continued genetic diversification within the circulating Cosmopolitan lineage. Overall, these findings demonstrate the persistence of established DENV lineages alongside ongoing viral evolution during the 2023 outbreak in Vietnam. This study highlights the value of whole-genome surveillance for monitoring dengue virus genetic diversity and provides insight that may support future epidemiological surveillance, vaccine evaluation, and outbreak preparedness.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解2023年越南Vung Tau地区登革病毒暴发期间DENV-1和DENV-2基因型的遗传多样性和共循环情况,鉴于登革病毒(DENV)对全球健康构成重大威胁,特别是在登革热高度流行地区如越南。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究通过从148名住院患者(66.89%为成人)中收集分离株,并对其中53株进行全基因组测序,以表征2023年越南Vung Tau地区的登革病毒暴发。
elements_zh.methods: 分离株采用低传代、抗体依赖性增强(ADE)为基础的系统进行培养,对53株分离株进行全基因组测序,获得了47个共识序列,其中包括26个完整的基因组。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析显示,DENV-1和DENV-2多种基因型同时共循环。DENV-1分离株主要为基因型I(86%)和基因型IV(14%),而DENV-2分离株主要为宇宙型基因型(98%)。两种基因型均与之前报道的越南及东南亚地区分离株聚类,表明病毒在当地持续传播并存在区域间的病毒交换。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究突显了已建立的DENV谱系与持续遗传多样化的共存,为了解2023年越南登革病毒暴发期间DENV-1和DENV-2的遗传多样性和共循环提供了见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可通过监测登革病毒的遗传多样性,支持未来的流行病学监测、疫苗评估和暴发准备。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于样本量,且仅对148株分离株中的53株进行了测序,这可能影响遗传多样性分析的全面性。证据强度为中等。

papers.title: An overview of current technologies in the development of drugs and vaccines against dengue virus.
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne flavivirus with four distinct serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) and is endemic in tropical and subtropical regions worldwide. It can cause a range of illnesses, from self-resolving dengue fever to severe dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome. Dengue fever is a major public health hazard in tropical and subtropical areas. Advances in treatment and prevention have mainly focused on developing vaccines and antiviral medications. Currently, no treatment for dengue fever works for everyone. While some antiviral candidates are in clinical trials, most remain in preclinical or early research stages. Regarding vaccinations, the WHO has approved or prequalified two live-attenuated options: TAK-003 (Qdenga®) and Dengvaxia® (CYD-TDV). However, both vaccines have drawbacks, including limited effectiveness across serotypes and safety issues in seronegative individuals. Current research aims to elucidate the complex host immune responses that underlie dengue pathogenesis and vaccine-induced protection, to develop more effective treatments and preventive measures. Critically, most approaches remain at the experimental or preclinical stage and require further clinical evaluation.
papers.journal: Infection, genetics and evolution : journal of molecular epidemiology and evolutionary genetics in infectious diseases

analysis.summary_en: This review provides an overview of current technologies in the development of drugs and vaccines against dengue virus. Dengue virus, with four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4), is a major public health hazard in tropical and subtropical regions. The review highlights that while some antiviral candidates are in clinical trials, most remain in preclinical or early research stages. Two vaccines, TAK-003 (Qdenga®) and Dengvaxia® (CYD-TDV), have been approved by the WHO, but they face challenges such as limited effectiveness across serotypes and safety concerns in seronegative individuals. The review emphasizes the need for further research to better understand host immune responses and develop more effective treatments and preventive measures. Overall, the review underscores the importance of continued clinical evaluation and innovation in addressing dengue disease.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒(DENV)是一种通过蚊子传播的黄病毒,具有四种不同血清型(DENV-1至DENV-4),在全球热带和亚热带地区流行。它可导致一系列疾病,从自限性登革热到重症登革热出血热或登革热休克综合征。登革热是热带和亚热带地区的主要公共卫生危害。对治疗和预防的研究主要集中在开发疫苗和抗病毒药物药物上。目前,没有针对登革热的治疗能够对所有人有效。虽然部分抗病毒药物候选药物已进入临床试验,但大多数仍处于临床前或早期研究阶段。关于疫苗接种,世卫组织已批准或预认证两种减毒活疫苗:TAK-003(Qdenga®)和Dengvaxia®(CYD‐TDV)。然而,这两种疫苗均存在局限,包括对不同血清型的效力有限以及在血清阴性个体中的安全性问题。当前研究旨在阐明导致登革热发病机制和疫苗诱导保护的复杂宿主 免疫应答,以开发更有效的治疗和预防措施。关键是,大多数方法仍停留在实验或临床前阶段,需要进一步的临床评估。

analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 世界卫生组织已批准或预认证了两种减毒活疫苗:TAK-003(Qdenga®)和Dengvaxia®(CYD-TDV)。然而,这两种疫苗都有局限性,包括在不同血清型上的有效性有限以及在血清阴性个体中的安全性问题。在治疗和预防方面取得的进展主要集中在开发疫苗和抗病毒药物药物上。虽然有一些抗病毒药物候选药物正在进行临床试验,但大多数仍处于前期研究阶段。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 目前,没有一种治疗对登革热有效。

papers.title: Characterization of acute dengue immune status and serotype surveillance in three regions of Burkina Faso: a hospital-based cross-sectional study.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In recent years, dengue has become a significant public health concern in Burkina Faso, associated with severe disease and death. Rapid characterization of acute dengue serostatus is useful for identifying patients at risk, informing transmission dynamics, and supporting public health decision-making. This study aimed to characterize dengue immune status in three regions of Burkina Faso to inform pre-vaccination screening, evaluate a commercial combined DENV NS1, IgM, and IgG rapid diagnostic test (RDT) kit, and investigate DENV serotype circulation. METHODS: A multicenter study was conducted between 2023 and 2025 in Bobo-Dioulasso, Houndé, Ouagadougou, and Gaoua. Blood samples were collected from patients with suspected dengue. Acute DENV infections and serotypes were identified using real-time RT-PCR, and immune status was characterized by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) according to WHO criteria. Serum samples were screened using the reference standard (RT-PCR combined with ELISA) to evaluate the performance of a commercial DENV NS1, IgM, and IgG RDT kit in characterizing dengue immune status. RESULTS: Primary dengue accounted for 75.9%, 80.4%, and 71.4% in 2023, 2024, and 2025, respectively. The sensitivity of the RDT for determining primary and post-primary dengue during the first 5 days of illness was 93.3% and 94.7%, respectively. DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3 accounted for 47.0%, 5.6%, and 47.4% of cases, respectively. DENV-4 was not detected. The diagnostic specificity of the RDT for both primary and post-primary dengue was 100%. CONCLUSIONS: Primary dengue cases predominated, while severe dengue was associated with post-primary infection. The RDT proved to be a useful point-of-care tool for discriminating dengue immune status. DENV-3 and DENV-1 were the predominant serotypes driving recent transmission dynamics. The findings may help inform future vaccination strategies.

papers.title: Regional and Temporal Dynamics of Dengue in Mexico (2020-2024): A Comprehensive Epidemiological Analysis.
papers.abstract: Dengue remains a major public health concern in Mexico, with incidence and clinical burden increasing substantially in recent years. Using national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024, this study provides a comprehensive overview of the changing epidemiological landscape, with an emphasis on geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. Over this period, Mexico saw an almost fivefold increase in dengue cases, reaching over 123,000 confirmed infections and 426 deaths in 2024, the highest annual number recorded. Seasonal patterns shifted, with sustained transmission extending into unusual winter months from late 2023. Serotyping data revealed a shift in predominant virus serotypes, with DENV2 predominating until 2022, DENV1 peaking in 2021, and DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward, becoming dominant in 2023 and almost exclusive by 2024. This shift coincided with a sustained rise in dengue with warning signs (from 16.9% in 2020 to > 42% in 2023-2024) and higher hospitalisation rates, while severe dengue remained below 5%. Although DENV3 dominated nationally, DENV1 and DENV2 persisted in specific states, and DENV4 circulated sporadically, particularly in southern and northern regions. Several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, underscoring the potential for sudden epidemic expansion. Climatic analysis showed a consistent positive association between temperature and DENV3 prevalence, with precipitation effects varying by year. Odds ratio analysis suggested serotype-specific differences in severity across years. These findings underscore the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of dengue transmission in Mexico and highlight the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the regional and temporal dynamics of dengue in Mexico from 2020 to 2024, examining geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. The central question is to understand how dengue transmission patterns have evolved over this period and their implications for public health.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review utilizes national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024 to provide a comprehensive overview of dengue's changing epidemiological landscape. The study design includes analysis of serotype-specific data, climatic factors, and hospitalization rates. The review does not explicitly mention meta-analysis or consensus processes, but it relies on systematic data collection and interpretation.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review reports a fivefold increase in dengue cases in Mexico from 2020 to 2024, with DENV3 becoming dominant by 2024. It also highlights a shift in predominant serotypes over the years, with DENV2, DENV1, and DENV3 showing varying prevalence. Additionally, it notes that severe dengue remained below 5% of cases, while warning signs increased significantly.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies a shift in seasonal patterns, with transmission extending into unusual winter months from late 2023. It also notes that while DENV3 dominated nationally, DENV1 and DENV2 persisted in specific states, and DENV4 circulated sporadically. These findings suggest heterogeneity in transmission dynamics, which may be influenced by climatic factors and regional differences.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies due to the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of dengue transmission in Mexico. It also highlights the importance of monitoring serotype-specific trends and their impact on disease severity and hospitalization rates.

analysis.summary_en: This review provides a comprehensive analysis of dengue dynamics in Mexico from 2020 to 2024, focusing on geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype shifts, and disease severity. It reports a fivefold increase in dengue cases, with DENV3 becoming dominant by 2024. The study highlights the shift in predominant serotypes over the years and notes that severe dengue remained below 5% of cases. Seasonal patterns have changed, with transmission extending into winter months. The findings underscore the need for regional surveillance and tailored prevention strategies. The review also identifies gaps in understanding serotype-specific severity and the role of climatic factors in transmission dynamics.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于2020年至2024年墨西哥登革热的区域与时间动态,分析了地理分布、时间趋势、血清型动态以及疾病严重程度。核心问题是了解这一时期登革热传播模式的变化及其对公共卫生的影响。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述使用2020年至2024年的全国登革热数据,全面概述了登革热流行病学景观的变化。研究设计包括对血清型特异性数据、气候因素和入院率的分析。综述未明确提及荟萃分析或共识过程,但依赖于系统性的数据收集和解释。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述报告称,2020年至2024年墨西哥的登革热病例数增加了五倍,DENV3在2024年成为主导血清型。它还指出,近年来主要血清型发生了变化,DENV2、DENV1和DENV3的流行率各有不同。此外,它还提到重症登革热病例仍低于5%,而警告信号显著增加。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出季节性模式发生了变化,登革热传播从2023年底延伸到了不寻常的冬季月份。它还提到虽然DENV3在全国范围内占主导地位,但DENV1和DENV2在某些州仍持续存在,而DENV4则偶有流行。这些发现表明传播模式存在异质性,可能受到气候因素和区域差异的影响。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述强调,由于墨西哥登革热传播模式的异质性和动态性,需要制定区域性监测、预防和临床准备策略。它还指出,监测血清型特异性趋势及其对疾病严重程度和入院率的影响至关重要。

It also highlights a shift in predominant serotypes over the years, with DENV2, DENV1, and DENV3 showing varying prevalence. Additionally, it notes that severe dengue remained below 5% of cases, while warning signs increased significantly.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies a shift in seasonal patterns, with transmission extending into unusual winter months from late 2023. It also notes that while DENV3 dominated nationally, DENV1 and DENV2 persisted in specific states, and DENV4 circulated sporadically. These findings suggest heterogeneity in transmission dynamics, which may be influenced by climatic factors and regional differences.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies due to the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of dengue transmission in Mexico. It also highlights the importance of monitoring serotype-specific trends and their impact on disease severity and hospitalization rates.

papers.title_zh: 墨西哥2020-2024年登革热的区域与时间动态:一项全面的流行病学分析。
papers.source_body_en: Dengue remains a major public health concern in Mexico, with incidence and clinical burden increasing substantially in recent years. Using national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024, this study provides a comprehensive overview of the changing epidemiological landscape, with an emphasis on geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. Over this period, Mexico saw an almost fivefold increase in dengue cases, reaching over 123,000 confirmed infections and 426 deaths in 2024, the highest annual number recorded. Seasonal patterns shifted, with sustained transmission extending into unusual winter months from late 2023. Serotyping data revealed a shift in predominant virus serotypes, with DENV2 predominating until 2022, DENV1 peaking in 2021, and DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward, becoming dominant in 2023 and almost exclusive by 2024. This shift coincided with a sustained rise in dengue with warning signs (from 16.9% in 2020 to > 42% in 2023-2024) and higher hospitalisation rates, while severe dengue remained below 5%. Although DENV3 dominated nationally, DENV1 and DENV2 persisted in specific states, and DENV4 circulated sporadically, particularly in southern and northern regions. Several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, underscoring the potential for sudden epidemic expansion. Climatic analysis showed a consistent positive association between temperature and DENV3 prevalence, with precipitation effects varying by year. Odds ratio analysis suggested serotype-specific differences in severity across years. These findings underscore the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of dengue transmission in Mexico and highlight the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热仍然是墨西哥的主要公共卫生问题,近年来其流行程度和临床负担显著增加。本研究利用2020年至2024年的全国登革热数据,全面概述了登革热流行病学景观的变化,重点分析了地理分布、时间趋势、血清型动态以及疾病严重程度。在这一时期,墨西哥的登革热病例数几乎增加了五倍,2024年达到超过123,000例确诊病例和426例死亡,这是有记录以来最高的年度病例数。季节性模式发生了变化,持续的登革热传播从2023年底延伸到了不寻常的冬季月份。血清型数据揭示了主要病毒血清型的变化,DENV2在2022年之前占主导地位,DENV1在2021年达到高峰,而DENV3则从2022年开始急剧上升,成为2023年的主导血清型,并在2024年几乎成为唯一流行的血清型。这种变化与登革热病例数的持续上升以及警告信号的增加(从2020年的16.9%上升到2023-2024年的>42%)相吻合,同时医院入院率也显著提高,而重症登革热病例仍低于5%。尽管DENV3在全国范围内占主导地位,但DENV1和DENV2在某些州仍持续存在,而DENV4则在南部和北部地区偶有流行。一些传统上登革热流行率较低的州出现了非典型的流行模式,突显了登革热暴发可能突然扩展的潜在风险。气候分析显示,温度与DENV3的流行率之间存在一致的正相关关系,而降水的影响则因年份而异。比值比分析表明,不同血清型在不同年份的严重程度存在差异。这些发现突显了墨西哥登革热传播模式的异质性和动态性,并强调了制定区域性监测、预防和临床准备策略的必要性。

papers.title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过从植物来源的天然产物中鉴定新型抗病毒药物化合物,解决针对蚊媒虫媒病毒(特别是登革病毒,即登革病毒DENV)的特定抗病毒药物疗法的未满足需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用生物活性导向的方法,筛选八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物,评估其对Vero细胞中DENV-2的抗病毒药物活性。
elements_zh.methods: 对茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行筛选,评估其对Vero细胞中DENV-2的抗病毒药物活性。使用功能实验检测病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及感染性病毒滴度。通过超高效液相色谱-二极管阵列检测器-质谱(UPLC-DAD-MS)和一维/二维核磁共振(1D/2D NMR)光谱进行结构表征。进行分子对接分析以预测与关键病毒酶的相互作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,在非细胞毒性浓度下,Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.实现了完全抑制。功能实验表明,分离出的螺甾烷型甾体皂苷抑制了DENV的复制,显著降低了病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及感染性病毒滴度。这些化合物还保留了对ZIKV和CHIKV的抗病毒药物活性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为登革热及其他相关虫媒病毒的新型抗病毒药物疗法的开发提供信息,从而潜在地减少这些感染对全球公共卫生的负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于仅使用了一种DENV-2毒株,并且缺乏体内研究,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。由于研究为体外实验,其证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV))构成了日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前针对这些感染的特异性抗病毒药物疗法尚不普及。这种未满足的医疗需求凸显了从生物相关来源(如植物来源的天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。随后的分级和纯化过程分离出四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷,其结构通过超高效液相色谱-二极管阵列检测-质谱(UPLC-DAD-MS)和一维/二维核磁共振(1D/2D NMR)光谱进行表征。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制DENV复制,表现为病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的显著下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,这与抑制病毒复制和/或蛋白质加工一致。分子对接分析支持这些发现,预测这些化合物与关键病毒酶(特别是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶)具有有利的相互作用。重要的是,分离出的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV也表现出抗病毒药物活性,表明其具有跨虫媒病毒的疗效。综上所述,这些发现表明螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过从植物来源的天然产物中鉴定新型抗病毒药物化合物,解决针对蚊媒虫媒病毒(特别是登革病毒,即登革病毒DENV)的特定抗病毒药物疗法的未满足需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用生物活性导向的方法,筛选八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物,评估其对Vero细胞中DENV-2的抗病毒药物活性。
analysis_zh.methods: 对茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行筛选,评估其对Vero细胞中DENV-2的抗病毒药物活性。使用功能实验检测病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及感染性病毒滴度。通过超高效液相色谱-二极管阵列检测器-质谱(UPLC-DAD-MS)和一维/二维核磁共振(1D/2D NMR)光谱进行结构表征。进行分子对接分析以预测与关键病毒酶的相互作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: 五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,在非细胞毒性浓度下,Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.实现了完全抑制。功能实验表明,分离出的螺甾烷型甾体皂苷抑制了DENV的复制,显著降低了病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及感染性病毒滴度。这些化合物还保留了对ZIKV和CHIKV的抗病毒药物活性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为登革热及其他相关虫媒病毒的新型抗病毒药物疗法的开发提供信息,从而潜在地减少这些感染对全球公共卫生的负担。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于仅使用了一种DENV-2毒株,并且缺乏体内研究,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。由于研究为体外实验,其证据强度中等。

papers.title: Computational Insights Into the Conformational Dynamics of the Dengue Virus Capsid Protein.
papers.abstract: The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. Capsid protein includes a hydrophobic pocket, which plays a central role in these functions and switches between closed and open conformations. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. In the open conformation, the pocket is involved in the interaction with lipids, stabilization of capsid dimers, and the promotion of immature virus assembly. Conversely, the closed conformation protects the hydrophobic pocket from the surrounding aqueous media as also preventing premature interactions in the solution phase that might disrupt protein stability. Such insights allow a deep understanding of capsid protein's conformational dynamics and represent a promising set of potent targets for antiviral strategies aiming to interfere with its functional transitions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the conformational dynamics of the Dengue virus capsid protein, focusing on the hydrophobic pocket's role in viral lifecycle functions and transitions between open and closed conformations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research employed molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods to study the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein.
analysis.methods: Molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods were used to investigate the structural rearrangements governing the transitions of the capsid protein's hydrophobic pocket.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket, and the open conformation facilitates interactions with lipids and virus assembly, while the closed conformation protects the pocket from aqueous media and premature interactions.

These insights could inform antiviral strategies targeting the capsid protein's functional transitions.

papers.title_zh: 对 登革病毒 衣壳蛋白构象动力学的计算见解。
papers.source_body_en: The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 衣壳蛋白在病毒生命周期中发挥重要作用,包括 基因组 的衣壳化、脂滴的招募和颗粒的组装。衣壳蛋白包含一个疏水口袋,它在这些功能以及闭合和开放构象之间的转换中发挥着核心作用。这项工作研究了衣壳蛋白的构象变化途径,特别是如何控制控制疏水袋打开和关闭的分子机制。通过结合使用不同类型的分子动力学模拟和增强的采样方法,我们分享了对在控制这些转变中发挥关键作用的结构重排的见解。我们的结果表明,脂质结合通过环境因素调节疏水袋的可及性。在开放构象中,口袋参与与脂质的相互作用、衣壳二聚体的稳定以及促进未成熟病毒的组装。相反,闭合构象可以保护疏水袋免受周围水介质的影响,同时还可以防止溶液相中过早的相互作用,从而破坏蛋白质的稳定性。这些见解使人们能够深入了解衣壳蛋白的构象动力学,并为旨在干扰其功能转变的 抗病毒药物 策略提供了一组有前景的有效靶标。

papers.title: Targeting CLK1 by CRISPR tools and pharmacological inhibition modulates the innate immune response and dengue virus replication
papers.abstract: Alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism known to be altered upon viral infection. These alterations can arise both from direct viral interference with the splicing machinery and from cellular responses such as activation of innate immunity. Here, we investigated splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells, the latter serving as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation. Among the common events, we identified an increased production of non-coding mRNA isoforms from the CLK1 gene, which gives rise to a kinase that phosphorylates splicing factors including SR proteins and spliceosomal components. Consistent with this finding, IFN treatment led to a reduction in CLK1 protein levels. Using stable cell lines with CRISPR/dCas9-mediated modulation of CLK1 expression, we found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its over-expression attenuated it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with the pharmacological inhibitor TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. Altogether, these results identify CLK1 as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression and suggest that its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses and become a target for therapeutic strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells, as these alterations are known to arise from both direct viral interference and cellular responses such as activation of innate immunity.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in cultured cells, using interferon treatment as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation, and focused on dengue virus infection and IFN treatment.
analysis.methods: The researchers used CRISPR/dCas9-mediated modulation of CLK1 expression in stable cell lines and pharmacological inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with TG003 to assess its impact on immune response gene induction and DENV replication.
analysis.main_results: The study found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its over-expression attenuated it. Additionally, inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that CLK1 acts as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression, and its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into potential therapeutic strategies targeting CLK1 to enhance antiviral defenses against dengue virus.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to cultured cells and does not account for in vivo conditions, but the evidence is strong as it directly links CLK1 modulation to changes in immune response and DENV replication.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells. It identifies CLK1 as a gene whose expression is altered during these processes, with increased non-coding mRNA isoforms observed. The researchers used CRISPR/dCas9 and pharmacological inhibitors to modulate CLK1 expression and found that silencing CLK1 enhanced immune response gene induction, while its over-expression reduced it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. These results suggest CLK1 as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression, indicating its potential as a therapeutic target. The study's findings are significant for understanding antiviral defenses but are limited to in vitro models.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查登革病毒(登革病毒)感染与干扰素(IFN)治疗在培养细胞中共享的剪接变化,因为这些变化已知既可能源于病毒对剪接机制的直接干扰,也可能源于细胞反应,如先天免疫的激活。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在培养细胞中进行,使用干扰素治疗作为病毒独立先天免疫激活的模型,并聚焦于登革病毒感染和IFN 治疗。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用CRISPR/dCas9介导的CLK1表达调控和药理学抑制剂TG003抑制CLK1激酶活性,以评估其对免疫应答基因诱导和登革病毒复制的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,沉默CLK1增强了免疫应答基因的诱导,而其过表达则抑制了这种诱导。此外,使用TG003抑制CLK1激酶活性进一步增强了干扰素诱导的基因表达,并减少了登革病毒的复制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,CLK1作为干扰素诱导基因表达的促病毒负调控因子,其抑制可能增强抗病毒药物的防御能力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为针对CLK1的潜在治疗策略提供了见解,以增强抗病毒药物对登革病毒的防御能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于培养细胞,未考虑体内条件,但证据较强,因为它直接关联了CLK1的调控与免疫应答及登革病毒复制的变化。

analysis_en.main_results: The study found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its over-expression attenuated it. Additionally, inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that CLK1 acts as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression, and its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into potential therapeutic strategies targeting CLK1 to enhance antiviral defenses against dengue virus.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to cultured cells and does not account for in vivo conditions, but the evidence is strong as it directly links CLK1 modulation to changes in immune response and DENV replication.

papers.title_zh: 通过CRISPR工具靶向CLK1及药理学抑制调节先天免疫免疫应答和登革病毒的复制
papers.source_body_en: Alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism known to be altered upon viral infection. These alterations can arise both from direct viral interference with the splicing machinery and from cellular responses such as activation of innate immunity. Here, we investigated splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells, the latter serving as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation. Among the common events, we identified an increased production of non-coding mRNA isoforms from the CLK1 gene, which gives rise to a kinase that phosphorylates splicing factors including SR proteins and spliceosomal components. Consistent with this finding, IFN treatment led to a reduction in CLK1 protein levels. Using stable cell lines with CRISPR/dCas9-mediated modulation of CLK1 expression, we found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its over-expression attenuated it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with the pharmacological inhibitor TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. Altogether, these results identify CLK1 as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression and suggest that its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses and become a target for therapeutic strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 可变剪接是一种关键的调控机制,已知在病毒感染时会发生改变。这些改变可能源于病毒对剪接机制的直接干扰,也可能源于细胞反应,如先天免疫的激活。在此研究中,我们调查了登革病毒(登革病毒)感染与干扰素(IFN)治疗在培养细胞中共享的剪接变化,后者作为病毒独立先天免疫激活的模型。在这些共同事件中,我们发现CLK1基因产生了更多的非编码mRNA亚型,CLK1编码一种激酶,可磷酸化包括SR蛋白和剪接体成分在内的剪接因子。这一发现与IFN 治疗导致CLK1蛋白水平下降的结果一致。通过使用CRISPR/dCas9介导的CLK1表达稳定细胞系,我们发现沉默CLK1增强了免疫应答基因的诱导,而其过表达则抑制了这种诱导。此外,使用药理学抑制剂TG003抑制CLK1激酶活性进一步增强了干扰素诱导的基因表达,并减少了登革病毒的复制。综上所述,这些结果表明CLK1是干扰素诱导基因表达的促病毒负调控因子,并提示其抑制可能增强抗病毒药物的防御能力,成为治疗策略的潜在靶点。

papers.title: Impact of temperature on patient-derived dengue virus breakthrough infections in wMel-infected Aedes aegypti
papers.abstract: Abstract The w Mel strain of the insect endosymbiont Wolbachia reduces the potential for Aedes aegypti to transmit mosquito-borne viruses such as dengue (DENV). Field trials that have introgressed w Mel into Ae. aegypti populations have shown this approach significantly reduces dengue incidence. In a laboratory setting some w Mel- Ae. aegypti develop infectious saliva following a viremic blood meal. Additionally, studies have demonstrated that exposing w Mel- Ae. aegypti to heat treatment, particularly during the larval stage, reduces w Mel density in key tissues such as the ovaries, midgut and salivary glands. Here we build on these studies, using viremic blood collected from 13 dengue inpatients at the Hospital for Tropical Diseases in Ho Chi Minh City (Viet Nam), to assess how temperature affects the protection afforded to Ae. We found that, compared to w Mel- Ae. aegypti reared at 28 ± 4°C, those reared at 31 ± 4°C developed infectious saliva more frequently, but the risk of this occurring was still reduced compared to WT mosquitoes reared at the same temperature. Heat treatment reduced the density of w Mel in all tissues tested, decreased the magnitude of w Mel’s protection against DENV replication in the head/thorax, and significantly increased the amount of DENV replication in w Mel- Ae. When comparing cohorts of w Mel- Ae. aegypti that did or did not develop infectious saliva, DENV levels in the head/thorax were associated with increased odds of mosquitoes developing infectious saliva, but w Mel density was not. Overall, these findings show that elevated rearing temperatures increase the risk of patient-derived DENV breakthrough infections in w Mel- Ae. aegypti , potentially due to increased DENV replication in these mosquitoes. This limitation suggests it would be prudent to increase surveillance in regions using w Mel for dengue control when daily mean temperatures remain above 30°C for multiday periods. Author Summary The mosquito species Ae. aegypti can be infected with the bacterium Wolbachia ( w Mel strain), reducing its capacity to transmit viruses like dengue (DENV). Wolbachia is now being used as a biocontrol tool to reduce the burden of dengue in communities. However, some mosquitoes with Wolbachia can still transmit DENV. Here we utilised a natural infection model using dengue patient-derived blood to examine how temperature may increase the risk of DENV transmission occurrence in mosquitoes with w Mel. Mosquitoes with w Mel were more likely to transmit virus when reared at an average temperature of 31°C compared to those reared at an average temperature of 28°C but these mosquitoes still had a lower risk of developing infectious saliva compared to their w Mel-free counterparts. Higher temperatures reduced the amount of w Mel in mosquito tissues and increased the amount of DENV replicating in the head/thorax. Increasing levels of DENV RNA in these tissues were found to be associated with increased risk of mosquitoes with w Mel developing infectious saliva. This finding indicates surveillance is warranted in high temperature settings or during heat waves, to monitor for changes in w Mel frequency and DENV infection in Ae.

papers.title_zh: 温度对携带wMel的埃及伊蚊传播患者来源的登革病毒登革病毒突破性感染的影响
papers.source_body_en: Abstract The w Mel strain of the insect endosymbiont Wolbachia reduces the potential for Aedes aegypti to transmit mosquito-borne viruses such as dengue (DENV). Field trials that have introgressed w Mel into Ae. aegypti populations have shown this approach significantly reduces dengue incidence. In a laboratory setting some w Mel- Ae. aegypti develop infectious saliva following a viremic blood meal. Additionally, studies have demonstrated that exposing w Mel- Ae. aegypti to heat treatment, particularly during the larval stage, reduces w Mel density in key tissues such as the ovaries, midgut and salivary glands. Here we build on these studies, using viremic blood collected from 13 dengue inpatients at the Hospital for Tropical Diseases in Ho Chi Minh City (Viet Nam), to assess how temperature affects the protection afforded to Ae. We found that, compared to w Mel- Ae. aegypti reared at 28 ± 4°C, those reared at 31 ± 4°C developed infectious saliva more frequently, but the risk of this occurring was still reduced compared to WT mosquitoes reared at the same temperature. Heat treatment reduced the density of w Mel in all tissues tested, decreased the magnitude of w Mel’s protection against DENV replication in the head/thorax, and significantly increased the amount of DENV replication in w Mel- Ae. When comparing cohorts of w Mel- Ae. aegypti that did or did not develop infectious saliva, DENV levels in the head/thorax were associated with increased odds of mosquitoes developing infectious saliva, but w Mel density was not. Overall, these findings show that elevated rearing temperatures increase the risk of patient-derived DENV breakthrough infections in w Mel- Ae. aegypti , potentially due to increased DENV replication in these mosquitoes. This limitation suggests it would be prudent to increase surveillance in regions using w Mel for dengue control when daily mean temperatures remain above 30°C for multiday periods. Author Summary The mosquito species Ae. aegypti can be infected with the bacterium Wolbachia ( w Mel strain), reducing its capacity to transmit viruses like dengue (DENV). Wolbachia is now being used as a biocontrol tool to reduce the burden of dengue in communities. However, some mosquitoes with Wolbachia can still transmit DENV. Here we utilised a natural infection model using dengue patient-derived blood to examine how temperature may increase the risk of DENV transmission occurrence in mosquitoes with w Mel. Mosquitoes with w Mel were more likely to transmit virus when reared at an average temperature of 31°C compared to those reared at an average temperature of 28°C but these mosquitoes still had a lower risk of developing infectious saliva compared to their w Mel-free counterparts. Higher temperatures reduced the amount of w Mel in mosquito tissues and increased the amount of DENV replicating in the head/thorax. Increasing levels of DENV RNA in these tissues were found to be associated with increased risk of mosquitoes with w Mel developing infectious saliva. This finding indicates surveillance is warranted in high temperature settings or during heat waves, to monitor for changes in w Mel frequency and DENV infection in Ae.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要:wMel株沃尔巴克氏体(Wolbachia)作为一种昆虫共生菌,能够降低埃及伊蚊传播如登革病毒(DENV)等蚊媒病毒的潜力。在野外试验中,将wMel引入埃及伊蚊种群后,显示出显著降低登革病毒发病率的效果。在实验室环境下,一些携带wMel的埃及伊蚊在摄入病毒血餐后会发展出具有传染性的唾液。此外,研究表明,将携带wMel的埃及伊蚊暴露于高温治疗,尤其是在幼虫阶段,会降低其在卵巢、中肠和唾液腺等关键组织中的wMel密度。在此基础上,我们使用从胡志明市热带疾病医院13名登革热患者采集的病毒血餐,评估温度如何影响携带wMel的埃及伊蚊对病毒的保护作用。我们发现,与在28 ± 4°C条件下饲养的wMel-埃及伊蚊相比,那些在31 ± 4°C条件下饲养的个体更频繁地发展出具有传染性的唾液,但这种风险仍低于在相同温度下饲养的野生型(WT)蚊子。高温治疗降低了蚊子组织中的wMel密度,并减少了wMel对DENV在头部/胸部复制的保护作用,同时显著增加了wMel-埃及伊蚊中DENV的复制量。在比较携带wMel的埃及伊蚊是否发展出传染性唾液时,发现头部/胸部中的DENV水平与蚊子发展出传染性唾液的可能性增加相关,但wMel密度则没有这种关联。总体而言,这些发现表明,较高的饲养温度可能增加携带wMel的埃及伊蚊发生患者来源的DENV突破性感染的风险,这可能归因于这些蚊子中DENV的复制增加。这一局限性表明,在日均气温持续高于30°C的地区,应考虑增加监测,以监测wMel频率和DENV感染率的变化。作者摘要:埃及伊蚊可以感染沃尔巴克氏体(wMel株),从而降低其传播如登革病毒(DENV)等病毒的能力。目前,沃尔巴克氏体正被用作生物控制工具,以减少登革热在社区中的负担。然而,一些携带沃尔巴克氏体的蚊子仍可能传播DENV。在此研究中,我们利用自然感染模型,使用来自登革热患者的病毒血餐来探讨温度如何增加携带wMel的蚊子发生DENV 传播的可能性。与在平均温度28°C下饲养的蚊子相比,携带wMel的蚊子在平均温度31°C下更可能传播病毒,但它们发展出传染性唾液的风险仍低于无wMel的对照蚊子。较高的温度降低了蚊子组织中的wMel含量,并增加了DENV在头部/胸部的复制量。研究发现,这些组织中DENV RNA水平的增加与携带wMel的蚊子发展出传染性唾液的风险增加相关。这一发现表明,在高温环境或热浪期间,应增加监测,以监测埃及伊蚊种群中沃尔巴克氏体频率和DENV感染率的变化。

papers.title: Peer Review Report For: Clinical Characteristics, Associated Factors, Treatment Practices, and Outcomes of Dengue Fever among Adult Acute Febrile Illness Cases in Las’anod, Sool Region, Somalia: A Hospital-Based Cross-Sectional Study [version 1; peer review: 1 approved with reservations]
papers.abstract: Abstract Fever, or pyrexia, is the controlled elevation of an individual’s core body temperature above the normal “set point,” which is regulated by the anterior hypothalamus. Although in both hospital and outpatient settings the usual practice is to treat fever, little to no evidence supports the widespread use of antipyretic drugs, such as non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs or acetaminophen, to reduce fever in self-limited infections. A large body of research supports the idea that fever has evolved as a host defense mechanism against infection that improves survival. Fever enhances immune responses, amplifies the effects of cytokines and other components of the innate immune system through a coordinated process known as the “acute phase response,” and works synergistically with other defense/immune mechanisms to inhibit microbial growth. Randomized clinical trials lowering body temperature show either no benefit, increased morbidity, or a trend toward increased mortality. These results, along with the findings of observational studies, are consistent with fever as a protective response to infection.

The results contribute to the understanding of fever's role in dengue disease and have implications for clinical management and future research.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项在索马里苏尔地区拉斯安多进行的基于医院的横断面研究,关注成人急性发热病例。研究纳入了登革热病例,并与其他发热病例进行了比较。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究收集了成人急性发热病例的临床特征、相关因素、治疗实践及结局的数据。采用横断面设计分析数据,并评估发热在登革热感染背景下的作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 降低体温的随机临床试验显示,要么无益,要么增加发病率,或显示出增加死亡率的趋势。这些发现表明,在自限性感染如登革热中,降低体温可能并不有益。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些结果解释为支持发热作为感染的保护性反应,这与关于其作为宿主防御机制作用的更广泛研究结果一致。本研究进一步支持发热在登革热感染中可能有益的观点。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对登革热的管理具有重要意义,表明在自限性感染中可能不推荐使用退热药物来降低体温。它们还强调了进一步研究发热在登革热疾病中作用的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计的限制,无法确定因果关系。证据强度中等,因为其依赖于观察性研究和随机试验,但与发热作为保护性反应的广泛理解一致。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 发热,或称为体温升高,是机体核心体温在正常“设定点”之上受前下丘脑调控的受控升高。尽管在医院和门诊环境中通常会治疗发热,但几乎没有证据支持广泛使用退热药物(如非甾体抗炎药或对乙酰氨基酚)来降低自限性感染中的体温。大量研究表明,发热作为一种宿主防御机制,有助于提高感染后的生存率。发热可以增强免疫应答,通过一种称为“急性期反应”的协调过程放大细胞因子和其他固有免疫系统的效应,并与其他防御/免疫机制协同作用以抑制微生物生长。降低体温的随机临床试验显示,要么无益,要么增加发病率,或显示出增加死亡率的趋势。这些结果与观察性研究的发现一致,支持发热作为感染的保护性反应。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨索马里苏尔地区拉斯安多成人急性发热病例的临床特征、相关因素、治疗实践及登革热结局。背景强调了理解发热作为宿主防御机制的重要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项在索马里苏尔地区拉斯安多进行的基于医院的横断面研究,关注成人急性发热病例。研究纳入了登革热病例,并与其他发热病例进行了比较。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究收集了成人急性发热病例的临床特征、相关因素、治疗实践及结局的数据。采用横断面设计分析数据,并评估发热在登革热感染背景下的作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: 降低体温的随机临床试验显示,要么无益,要么增加发病率,或显示出增加死亡率的趋势。这些发现表明,在自限性感染如登革热中,降低体温可能并不有益。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些结果解释为支持发热作为感染的保护性反应,这与关于其作为宿主防御机制作用的更广泛研究结果一致。本研究进一步支持发热在登革热感染中可能有益的观点。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对登革热的管理具有重要意义,表明在自限性感染中可能不推荐使用退热药物来降低体温。它们还强调了进一步研究发热在登革热疾病中作用的必要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计的限制,无法确定因果关系。证据强度中等,因为其依赖于观察性研究和随机试验,但与发热作为保护性反应的广泛理解一致。

papers.title: COST RECOVERY RATE OF HOSPITAL TARIFFS AND INA-CBGs REIMBURSEMENT FOR DENGUE HAEMORRHAGIC FEVER (DHF) AT TYPE C HOSPITAL IN INDONESIA
papers.abstract: The implementation of Indonesia's Case-Based Groups (INA-CBGs) payment system aims to improve efficiency in hospital financing. However, discrepancies between reimbursement and actual treatment costs remain a significant challenge for hospital financial sustainability. This study aimed to analyze the Cost Recovery Rate (CRR) by comparing hospital tariffs, INA-CBGs reimbursement, and the actual cost of treating Grade I Dengue Haemorrhagic Fever (DHF) patients while identifying factors contributing to cost discrepancies. A qualitative single embedded case study was conducted at a Type C private hospital in Palembang, Indonesia. Secondary financial and clinical data from 35 Class III inpatients with Grade I DHF were analyzed alongside semi-structured interviews with five key informants representing hospital management, clinical services, finance, and the casemix unit. Data were analyzed through document review, cost comparison, CRR calculation, and thematic analysis. The findings revealed differences between the hospital's internal tariff (Rp82,925,300), INA-CBGs reimbursement (Rp69,730,500), and the actual treatment cost (Rp72,479,198). The resulting Cost Recovery Rate (CRR) of 96.21% indicated that INA-CBGs reimbursement was insufficient to fully recover the actual cost of care. The financing gap was influenced by the interaction of several factors, including the package-based INA-CBGs payment mechanism, length of hospital stay, patients' clinical conditions, diagnosis and procedure coding accuracy, adherence to clinical pathways, laboratory and pharmaceutical utilization, and overall hospital resource efficiency. This study demonstrates that financial sustainability under the INA-CBGs system depends not only on reimbursement policies but also on integrated clinical and operational management. Strengthening clinical pathway adherence, documentation and coding accuracy, resource utilization, and cost monitoring may improve hospital financial performance while maintaining the quality and safety of patient care.

papers.abstract_zh: 印尼实施基于病例的组(INA-CBGs)支付制度旨在提高医院资金使用的效率。然而,报销金额与实际治疗成本之间的差异仍然是医院财务可持续性面临的重要挑战。本研究旨在通过比较医院收费、INA-CBGs报销以及治疗一级登革出血热(DHF)患者的实际治疗成本,分析成本回收率(CRR),并识别导致成本差异的因素。研究在印尼巴淡市的一家类型C私立医院中开展,采用定性单嵌入案例研究方法,分析了35名一级DHF患者的二次财务和临床数据,并结合与五位关键知情人士的半结构化访谈,这些知情人士分别代表医院管理、临床服务、财务和病例混合单位。数据通过文件审查、成本比较、CRR计算和主题分析进行分析。研究结果表明,医院内部收费(Rp82,925,300)、INA-CBGs报销(Rp69,730,500)以及治疗一级DHF患者的实际治疗成本(Rp72,479,198)之间存在差异。由此得出的成本回收率(CRR)为96.21%,表明INA-CBGs报销不足以完全覆盖实际护理成本。资金缺口受到多种因素的相互作用影响,包括基于套餐的INA-CBGs支付机制、住院天数、患者的临床状况、诊断和程序编码的准确性、遵循临床路径的情况、实验室和药品的使用情况以及医院整体资源利用效率。本研究显示,在INA-CBGs体系下,医院的财务可持续性不仅取决于报销政策,还依赖于临床与运营的综合管理。加强临床路径的遵循、文档和编码的准确性、资源利用效率以及成本监控,可能在保持患者护理质量和安全的同时,提高医院的财务表现。

papers.title: A High-Content Pseudotime Framework for Morphological Profiling of Dengue Virus Inhibitors from a Drug-Repurposing Library
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) causes dengue fever, a globally prevalent, epidemic-prone disease with no FDA-approved antivirals. Additionally, the available vaccine for DENV can increase the risk of severe dengue fever for those who have never had a DENV infection due to antibody-dependent enhancement. Thus, there is an urgent need to identify DENV antivirals. Drug repurposing, high-content screening, and machine learning were leveraged to efficiently identify antivirals likely to inhibit DENV replication. Using high-content screening in a DENV infection model, we characterized the morphological patterns of NS4B and envelope (E) protein expression over time and developed a viral pseudotime model that predicts infection progression to aid in phenotypic interpretation of drug effects. We then developed a single cell infection classifier for antiviral efficacy and performed high-throughput drug screening of 960 compounds. We identified four concentration-dependent inhibitors of DENV with nanomolar-to-submicromolar potencies: esomeprazole, GW4064, pralatrexate, and LY411575. With our pseudotime machine learning model trained on data from the time-series assay, we scored the concentration-dependent inhibitors to map their mechanism of action onto time points in the viral life cycle. Our most notable results show that LY411575, a gamma secretase inhibitor, exhibited an IC of 72 nM and reduced percent infection to near the level of the mock infection control. Pseudotime inferences generated mechanistic predictions that were supported by time-of-addition experiments, indicating that LY411575 arrests DENV infection before the development of late-stage infection associated morphologies, while retaining activity when added after inoculation.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒(登革病毒)导致登革热,这是一种全球范围内广泛流行且易暴发的疾病,目前尚无FDA批准的抗病毒药物。此外,现有的疫苗可能会增加从未感染过登革病毒的人群患重症登革热发热的风险。因此,迫切需要识别登革病毒的抗病毒药物。本研究利用药物再利用、高通量筛选和机器学习方法,高效地识别可能抑制登革病毒复制的抗病毒药物。通过在登革病毒感染模型中进行高通量筛选,我们描述了NS4B和包膜(E)蛋白表达随时间变化的形态学模式,并开发了一种病毒伪时间模型,用于预测感染进展,从而有助于药物效应的表型解释。随后,我们开发了一种单细胞感染分类器,用于评估抗病毒药物的疗效,并进行了960种化合物的高通量药物筛选。我们鉴定了四种浓度依赖性抑制剂,其对登革病毒的抑制效力范围为纳摩尔至亚微摩尔:埃索美拉唑(esomeprazole)、GW4064、普拉拉特克斯(pralatrexate)和LY411575。通过我们的伪时间机器学习模型,该模型基于时间序列实验数据进行训练,我们对这些浓度依赖性抑制剂进行了评分,以将其作用机制映射到病毒生命周期中的特定时间点。我们最显著的结果表明,LY411575作为一种γ分泌酶抑制剂,其IC50为72 nM,并将感染百分比降低至接近假感染对照组的水平。伪时间推断生成的机制预测得到了时间添加实验的支持,表明LY411575在晚期感染相关形态学发展之前即可阻断登革病毒感染,而在接种后添加仍保持其活性。

papers.title: Genomic Diversity, Phylogenetic Structure, and In Silico Diagnostic Primer Compatibility of Available DENV-1 Genotype V from Mexico
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue virus serotype 1 (DENV-1) is prevalent across the Americas, yet its genomic diversity in Mexico is poorly characterized. Methods: We analyzed 119 public Mexican DENV-1 genomes (polyprotein CDS, 10,179 nt) alongside 111 from 19 other American countries and territories. The Mexican panel was temporally and geographically uneven (91% from 2006 to 2009), representing available sequences, not nationwide diversity. We assessed diversity, phylogeny, dating, selection, recombination, and compatibility with three primer sets. Results: The Mexican genotype V sequences formed 115 haplotypes (Hd = 0.9994; π = 0.00831), resolving into clades A (n = 6) and B (n = 112) plus one independent introduction in Jalisco. These sequences were not monophyletic: both clades grouped with Nicaraguan and United States viruses. Their common ancestor dated to 1977.5 and clade divergence to 1984.2. Selection appeared to be predominantly purifying (ω = 0.037); no site showed concordant evidence of diversifying selection, and no recombination was detected. In silico, 84% of Mexican sequences were compatible with all three CDC real-time oligonucleotides; none matched every oligonucleotide in either conventional set. Conclusions: This historical panel shows substantial haplotype diversity and multiple introductions. The compatibility results are computational and were not validated experimentally. We recommend periodic in silico primer revalidation.

Methods: We analyzed 119 public Mexican DENV-1 genomes (polyprotein CDS, 10,179 nt) alongside 111 from 19 other American countries and territories. The Mexican panel was temporally and geographically uneven (91% from 2006 to 2009), representing available sequences, not nationwide diversity. We assessed diversity, phylogeny, dating, selection, recombination, and compatibility with three primer sets. Results: The Mexican genotype V sequences formed 115 haplotypes (Hd = 0.9994; π = 0.00831), resolving into clades A (n = 6) and B (n = 112) plus one independent introduction in Jalisco. These sequences were not monophyletic: both clades grouped with Nicaraguan and United States viruses. Their common ancestor dated to 1977.5 and clade divergence to 1984.2. Selection appeared to be predominantly purifying (ω = 0.037); no site showed concordant evidence of diversifying selection, and no recombination was detected. In silico, 84% of Mexican sequences were compatible with all three CDC real-time oligonucleotides; none matched every oligonucleotide in either conventional set. Conclusions: This historical panel shows substantial haplotype diversity and multiple introductions. The compatibility results are computational and were not validated experimentally. We recommend periodic in silico primer revalidation.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the genomic diversity of DENV-1 genotype V in Mexico, revealing substantial haplotype diversity and multiple introductions. The Mexican sequences formed 115 haplotypes, resolving into clades A and B, with one independent introduction in Jalisco. These sequences were not monophyletic, grouping with Nicaraguan and United States viruses. The common ancestor of these sequences dated to 1977.5, and clade divergence occurred around 1984.2. In silico diagnostic primer compatibility showed 84% of Mexican sequences matched all three CDC real-time oligonucleotides. The findings highlight the need for periodic in silico primer revalidation to ensure accurate detection of DENV-1 genotype V in Mexico.

papers.title: A single dose of Dengvaxia is associated with transient reduction in dengue infection risk among dengue-naïve children
papers.abstract: Dengvaxia ® induces antibody responses in dengue virus (DENV)-naïve children, but the durability of these responses and their impact on subsequent wild-type (WT) DENV infection remain unclear. Although previous studies have primarily evaluated vaccine efficacy against dengue disease, the impact of Dengvaxia ® on susceptibility to WT DENV infection and subsequent immune responses remains less well defined. We evaluated vaccine-induced immunity and susceptibility to WT DENV infection in a longitudinal cohort of 186 seronegative children, including 114 who received a single dose of Dengvaxia ® and 72 who remained unvaccinated, followed for 40 months. Samples collected at baseline and two follow-up time points (20 months [T1] and 40 months [T2]) were analyzed using yellow fever virus (YFV) non-structural protein 1 (NS1) antibody assays, which is expressed by Dengvaxia ® but not by WT DENV, enabling discrimination between vaccine-associated and WT infection-induced responses. At T1, 61% of vaccinated children were responders. Additional low-level YFV NS1 antibody responses were detected in some children originally classified as vaccine non-responders, suggesting that the predefined binary classification may not capture the full range of vaccine-associated antibody responses. Low-level YFV NS1 responses remained detectable through T2. During the first follow-up period (baseline-T1), vaccination was associated with a reduced risk of WT DENV infection (vaccine effectiveness [VE]=45%). During the second period (T1-T2), no difference in infection risk was detected between groups. Following breakthrough infection during the first follow-up period, vaccinated children developed antibody responses with greater magnitude and broader serotype breadth than unvaccinated children with primary infection, consistent with vaccine-associated immune priming following WT DENV infection. In contrast, during the second period (T1-T2), differences in antibody magnitude and breadth following infection were no longer detected between groups. Together, these findings suggest that a single dose of Dengvaxia ® in DENV-seronegative children was associated with a reduced risk of WT DENV infection and with differences in subsequent antibody responses during the first follow-up period, but these associations were no longer observed during the second period.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估单剂量Dengvaxia®对登革热-免疫儿童野生型(WT)登革病毒(DENV)感染易感性的影响,解决疫苗诱导免疫持续性及其对随后感染影响的不确定性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项队列研究纵向研究,纳入186名血清阴性儿童,其中114名接受单剂量Dengvaxia®,72名未接种疫苗,随访40个月。
elements_zh.methods: 基线及两次随访时间点(20个月[T1]和40个月[T2])采集样本,使用黄热病毒(YFV)非结构蛋白1(NS1)抗体测定区分疫苗相关与WT感染诱导的应答。
elements_zh.main_results: T1时,61%的接种儿童为应答者。在第一随访期(基线-T1)内,疫苗接种与WT DENV感染风险降低相关(疫苗疗效[VE]=45%)。低水平YFV NS1应答在T2仍可检测到。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,单剂量Dengvaxia®在登革热-免疫儿童中与WT DENV感染风险降低及随后的抗体应答差异相关,但这些关联在第二随访期不再观察到。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对理解Dengvaxia®长期疗效及WT DENV感染后免疫应答具有意义,可为未来疫苗策略和监测工作提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究设计的局限包括潜在的混杂因素和需要更大样本量以推广结果。证据强度为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: Dengvaxia®在登革病毒(登革病毒)-免疫儿童中诱导抗体应答,但这些应答的持续性及其对随后的野生型(WT)DENV感染的影响尚不清楚。虽然先前研究主要评估疫苗对登革热疾病的疗效,但Dengvaxia®对WT DENV感染易感性及随后的免疫应答的影响尚不充分定义。我们在一项队列研究的纵向研究中评估了疫苗诱导的免疫和对WT DENV感染的易感性,该研究共纳入186名血清阴性儿童,其中114名接受单剂量Dengvaxia®,72名未接种疫苗,随访40个月。基线及两次随访时间点(20个月[T1]和40个月[T2])采集的样本使用黄热病毒(YFV)非结构蛋白1(NS1)抗体测定,YFV NS1由Dengvaxia®表达但WT DENV不表达,可区分疫苗相关与WT感染诱导的应答。在T1时,61%的接种儿童为应答者。部分原本被归类为疫苗非应答者的儿童检测到低水平YFV NS1抗体应答,提示预设的二元分类可能未能捕捉到疫苗相关抗体应答的完整范围。低水平YFV NS1应答在T2仍可检测到。在第一随访期(基线-T1)内,疫苗接种与WT DENV感染风险降低相关(疫苗疗效[VE]=45%)。在第二期(T1-T2)内,两组感染风险无差异。第一随访期突破感染后,接种儿童的抗体应答幅度更大、血清型覆盖更广,符合疫苗相关免疫预激在WT DENV感染后的表现。相反,在第二期(T1-T2)内,感染后抗体幅度和覆盖度的差异不再显现。综上所述,这些发现表明,在登革热-免疫儿童中,单剂量Dengvaxia®与WT DENV感染风险降低及随后的抗体应答差异相关,但这些关联在第二随访期不再观察到。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项队列研究纵向研究,纳入186名血清阴性儿童,其中114名接受单剂量Dengvaxia®,72名未接种疫苗,随访40个月。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对理解Dengvaxia®长期疗效及WT DENV感染后免疫应答具有意义,可为未来疫苗策略和监测工作提供信息。

papers.title_original: Unilateral Vocal Cord Paresis in Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever: A Rare Delayed Immune-mediated Neurological Manifestation and Complete Recovery

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to document a rare neurological complication of dengue hemorrhagic fever, specifically unilateral vocal cord paresis, and to highlight its potential as a delayed immune-mediated manifestation. Dengue virus is a significant public health threat, particularly in endemic regions, with evolving clinical presentations that require further understanding.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a case report describing an 18-year-old female patient with dengue hemorrhagic fever who developed unilateral vocal cord paresis on day 14 of fever. The patient was admitted to the ICU with dengue shock syndrome and traumatic liver injury, and her clinical course included significant initial abnormalities such as hemoglobin drop, thrombocytopenia, and elevated transaminases.
analysis.methods: The patient was diagnosed with dengue based on NS1 antigen positivity on day 1. Her clinical presentation, including neurological symptoms, was documented through medical records and physical examination. Laboratory tests were conducted to assess blood parameters, liver function, and other metabolic indicators.
analysis.main_results: The patient developed left vocal cord palsy on day 14 of fever, which resolved spontaneously without intervention. She was admitted to the ICU with dengue shock syndrome and traumatic liver injury, and her initial abnormalities included a hemoglobin drop (7.4 gm/dL), thrombocytopenia, elevated transaminases, and reduced albumin.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret this case as an example of a rare, delayed immune-mediated peripheral nervous system complication in dengue patients. This finding adds to the growing recognition of diverse neurological manifestations associated with dengue infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This case highlights the importance of considering immune-mediated neurological complications in dengue patients, particularly those with severe dengue. It underscores the need for vigilance in monitoring neurological symptoms in dengue-infected individuals.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As a case report, the study provides limited generalizability and lacks statistical analysis. However, the evidence is strong for the specific case described, offering a unique insight into dengue's potential neurological complications.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old female with dengue hemorrhagic fever who developed unilateral vocal cord paresis on day 14 of fever, followed by spontaneous recovery. The patient was admitted to the ICU with dengue shock syndrome and traumatic liver injury, presenting with significant initial abnormalities such as hemoglobin drop, thrombocytopenia, and elevated transaminases. The study highlights a rare, delayed immune-mediated neurological complication of dengue, contributing to the understanding of its diverse clinical manifestations. While the study is limited by its case report design, the findings provide valuable insight into the potential neurological effects of dengue infection, emphasizing the need for vigilance in monitoring patients for such complications.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在记录登革出血热的一种罕见神经并发症,特别是单侧声带麻痹,并强调其作为迟发性免疫介导表现的潜力。登革病毒 是一个重大的公共卫生威胁,特别是在流行地区,其临床表现不断变化,需要进一步了解。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究为 病例报告,描述了一名患有登革出血热的 18 岁女性患者,她在发烧第 14 天出现单侧声带麻痹。该患者因登革热休克综合征和创伤性肝损伤入住 ICU,其临床病程包括明显的初始异常,如血红蛋白下降、血小板减少和转氨酶升高。
elements_zh.methods: 患者在第1天因NS1抗原阳性被诊断为登革热。她的临床表现,包括神经症状,通过医疗记录和体格检查进行记录。进行了实验室检测以评估血液参数、肝功能和其他代谢指标。
elements_zh.main_results: 患者在发烧第14天出现左声带麻痹,无需干预即可自行消退。她因登革热休克综合征和创伤性肝损伤住进 ICU,最初的异常包括血红蛋白下降(7.4 gm/dL)、血小板减少、转氨酶升高和白蛋白减少。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此病例解释为登革热患者中罕见的迟发性免疫介导的周围神经系统并发症的一个例子。这一发现增加了人们对与登革热感染相关的多种神经系统表现的日益认识。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例强调了考虑登革热患者(尤其是 重症登革热 患者)免疫介导的神经系统并发症的重要性。它强调需要保持警惕,监测登革热感染者的神经系统症状。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为一项 病例报告,该研究提供的普遍性有限且缺乏统计分析。然而,所描述的具体病例证据确凿,为了解登革热潜在的神经系统并发症提供了独特的见解。

papers.title: Novel Omics Strategies To Combat Dengue Infection and Disease Progression
papers.abstract: The dengue virus (DENV) is a continuing global health threat rapidly spreading from its origins in tropical and subtropical regions. The virus is capable of causing severe and life-threatening diseases including dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) and dengue shock syndrome (DSS). Fortunately, mortality is drastically reduced with rapid diagnosis and treatment. Effective and efficient disease diagnosis and treatment, however, is limited by our knowledge of how the virus causes the disease; thus, no specific treatments are currently available to mitigate DENV infection. Novel state-of-the-art Omics approaches, which involve detecting and quantifying biological molecules, may be used to investigate how molecular and cellular pathways are perturbed during viral infection. These new approaches may serve as promising tools for discovering host biomarkers associated with infection and viral disease progression, and may unravel new host-directed therapeutic targets. In this article, we discuss the potential of these Omics approaches to revolutionize the diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of emerging and re-emerging viral diseases. Specifically, we ask how Omics methods can be integrated in the clinic to facilitate data collection for researchers, and how these data can influence our ability to diagnose, prognose, and treat those infected with DENV. We then investigate the host pathways involved in the progression from dengue fever to severe dengue (DHF and DSS), based on data found in preliminary Omics studies. Finally, in line with our holistic approach, we ask whether infection with the Zika virus influences DENV disease progression. Omics approaches have the potential to revolutionize our understanding of viral disease pathogenesis, but careful planning and collaboration with clinicians are required before such findings can be made.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 是一种持续的全球健康威胁,正从其热带和亚热带地区的起源快速传播。该病毒能够导致包括登革出血热 (DHF) 和登革休克综合征 (DSS) 在内的严重且危及生命的疾病。幸运的是,死亡率 在快速 诊断 和 治疗 下显著降低。有效且高效的疾病 诊断 和 治疗,然而,受限于我们对病毒致病机制的了解;因此,目前尚无特异性 治疗 可用于减轻 DENV 感染。新颖的最前沿组学方法,涉及检测和定量生物分子,可用于研究病毒感染期间分子和细胞通路的扰动。这些新方法可能成为发现与感染及病毒疾病进展相关的 宿主 生物标志物的有前景工具,并可能揭示新的 宿主 导向的治疗靶点。在本文中,我们讨论这些组学方法在革新 诊断、预后以及新兴和再现病毒疾病的 治疗 方面的潜力。具体而言,我们探讨组学方法如何在临床中整合,以促进研究者的数据收集,以及这些数据如何影响我们对 DENV 感染者的诊断、预后和治疗能力。随后,我们基于初步组学研究中发现的数据,研究从 登革热 到 重症登革热(DHF 和 DSS)进展过程中涉及的 宿主 通路。最后,秉持整体性方法,我们询问寨卡病毒感染是否影响 DENV 疾病进展。组学方法有潜力革新我们对病毒疾病 发病机制 的理解,但在此类发现能够实现之前,需要谨慎规划并与临床医生合作。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒 仍然是导致 DHF 和 DSS 等严重疾病的全球健康威胁,作者旨在确定如何将组学方法整合到临床实践中,以改进数据收集、诊断、预后以及 DENV 感染的 治疗。

papers.title: Entomological response to control interventions during the first chikungunya and dengue outbreak in White Nile, Sudan.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: White Nile State in south-central Sudan experienced its first documented outbreak of dengue and chikungunya in 2022. The present study evaluates the entomological response following an integrated vector management package implemented during the outbreak in Tandalti town. METHODS: Longitudinal entomological surveillance across 10 clusters encompassing 600 households and 2500 containers was conducted from July to December 2022. Stegomyia indices together with per-container productivity of larvae and pupae were calculated to quantify container infestation and evaluate entomological changes following the intervention. RESULTS: Widespread Aedes aegypti infestation was documented across all clusters, with clay pots (zeers) and barrels accounting for 97.1% of positive containers. Following the implementation of control interventions, Stegomyia indices decreased substantially from September to December (house index by 78.2%, container index by 35.1%, Breteau index by 92.8% and pupal/demographic index by 94.1%) and total immatures decreased by 89.5% (larvae) and 95.5% (pupae). The few residual containers remaining in December were still producing pupae at per-container rates comparable to baseline, with barrels sustaining higher productivity than zeers. CONCLUSIONS: The decrease in vector density is a combined effect of the control interventions and the wet to dry seasonal transition. Combining Stegomyia indices with per-container productivity identifies and quantifies residual containers sustaining the vector population. Sustained post-outbreak surveillance is needed, as these residual containers may contribute to vector population resurgence during subsequent transmission seasons.
papers.journal: Transactions of the Royal Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene

papers.title_zh: 白尼罗州首次白纹伊蚊和登革暴发的媒介生态响应
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: White Nile State in south-central Sudan experienced its first documented outbreak of dengue and chikungunya in 2022. The present study evaluates the entomological response following an integrated vector management package implemented during the outbreak in Tandalti town. METHODS: Longitudinal entomological surveillance across 10 clusters encompassing 600 households and 2500 containers was conducted from July to December 2022. Stegomyia indices together with per-container productivity of larvae and pupae were calculated to quantify container infestation and evaluate entomological changes following the intervention. RESULTS: Widespread Aedes aegypti infestation was documented across all clusters, with clay pots (zeers) and barrels accounting for 97.1% of positive containers. Following the implementation of control interventions, Stegomyia indices decreased substantially from September to December (house index by 78.2%, container index by 35.1%, Breteau index by 92.8% and pupal/demographic index by 94.1%) and total immatures decreased by 89.5% (larvae) and 95.5% (pupae). The few residual containers remaining in December were still producing pupae at per-container rates comparable to baseline, with barrels sustaining higher productivity than zeers. CONCLUSIONS: The decrease in vector density is a combined effect of the control interventions and the wet to dry seasonal transition. Combining Stegomyia indices with per-container productivity identifies and quantifies residual containers sustaining the vector population. Sustained post-outbreak surveillance is needed, as these residual containers may contribute to vector population resurgence during subsequent transmission seasons.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:苏丹中南部的白尼罗州在2022年首次记录了登革热和基孔肯雅热的暴发。本研究评估了在Tandalti镇于暴发期间实施的综合媒介管理方案后的昆虫学响应。方法:在2022年7月至12月,对包括600户家庭和2500个容器的10个集群进行纵向昆虫学监测。计算Stegomyia指数以及每容器幼虫和蛹的产量,以量化容器侵染程度并评估干预后的昆虫学变化。结果:在所有集群中记录到广泛的埃及伊蚊(Aedes aegypti)侵染,粘土罐(zeers)和桶占阳性容器的97.1%。在实施控制干预后,Stegomyia指数从9月到12月显著下降(住宅指数下降78.2%,容器指数下降35.1%,Breteau指数下降92.8%,蛹/人口指数下降94.1%),且总幼体数量分别下降89.5%(幼虫)和95.5%(蛹)。12月剩余的少数残留容器仍以与基线相当的每容器蛹产率产生蛹,且桶的产量高于zeers。结论:媒介密度的下降是控制干预与湿季向干季过渡共同作用的结果。将Stegomyia指数与每容器产量相结合,可识别并量化维持媒介种群的残留容器。需要持续的后暴发 监测,以防这些残留容器在后续传播季节导致媒介种群的再次暴发。

papers.title: DENGUE, ZIKA, AND CHIKUNGUNYA AMONG INDIGENOUS POPULATIONS IN AMAZONAS: EPIDEMIOLOGICAL ANALYSIS FROM 2021 TO 2025
papers.abstract: Introduction: The spread of arboviruses considered urban into Indigenous territories reflects a critical scenario of socio-environmental vulnerability and epidemiological transition. Objective: To describe cases of Dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika among the Indigenous population in Amazonas. Methodology: A retrospective descriptive study analyzing data from the epidemiological bulletin of the Amazonas Health Surveillance Foundation (FVS-RCP) covering the years 2021 to 2025. Results: Between January 2021 and December 2025, 32,730 cases of emerging arboviruses were reported in the state of Amazonas; of these, 31,401 (95.94%) were Dengue (DENV), 660 (2.02%) were Zika virus (ZIKV) infections, and 669 (2.04%) were Chikungunya (CHIKV). Considering the three arboviruses collectively, a slight female predominance was observed, accounting for approximately 52% of cases. Of the total notifications, 868 cases (2.65%) occurred in Indigenous individuals across all age groups, with the highest concentration in the 20–29 age range; this group represented 17% of DENV cases, 20% of ZIKV cases, and 16% of CHIKV cases. Cases were also identified among infants under one year of age (2% for DENV, 6% for ZIKV, and 2% for CHIKV) and among individuals aged 60 or older (6%, 4%, and 6%, respectively). Among Amazonas municipalities with significant Indigenous populations, Manaus, Tabatinga, and São Paulo de Olivença recorded the highest numbers of arbovirus cases, highlighting the occurrence of these infections across various age groups and territories within the state. Conclusion: To prevent the uncontrolled emergence of arboviral diseases among Indigenous populations in Amazonas, strategies must go beyond the urban model, integrating tailored health surveillance, respect for local culture, and territorial protection.
authors: Mirian Brasil da Silva e Silva

analysis.research_question_and_background: The spread of arboviruses into Indigenous territories highlights a critical socio‐environmental vulnerability and epidemiological transition, creating a need to document disease occurrence in this population; the study aimed to describe cases of Dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika among Indigenous people in Amazonas.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a retrospective descriptive analysis of 2021‐2025 surveillance data, and Indigenous individuals represented 868 cases (2.65%) of the 32,730 total notifications.
analysis.methods: A retrospective descriptive study analyzed surveillance bulletin data from 2021 to 2025, without experimental intervention, to characterize arbovirus cases.
analysis.main_results: Between January 2021 and December 2025, 32,730 arbovirus cases were reported in Amazonas, comprising 95.94% Dengue, 2.02% Zika, and 2.04% Chikungunya. Female cases represented about 52% of all infections, and 868 (2.65%) of cases occurred among Indigenous individuals, with higher proportions in the 20‐29 age group, while infants under one year and persons aged 60+ had specific percentages for each virus. The highest case counts were observed in the municipalities of Manaus, Tabatinga, and São Paulo de Olivença.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors conclude that preventing uncontrolled arboviral emergence in Indigenous Amazonas requires health surveillance, cultural respect, and territorial protection beyond the traditional urban model.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform targeted surveillance, culturally appropriate prevention, and territorial protection strategies for Indigenous communities to mitigate arboviral risks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The retrospective descriptive design based on surveillance bulletin data may suffer underreporting and limited demographic detail, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

analysis.summary_en: The study provides an epidemiological overview of Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya infections among Indigenous peoples in Amazonas from 2021 to 2025. A retrospective descriptive analysis of surveillance bulletin data captured 32,730 total arbovirus cases, of which 95.94% were Dengue, 2.02% Zika, and 2.04% Chikungunya. Female cases accounted for roughly 52% of infections, and 868 individuals (2.65%) were Indigenous, with the highest proportion in the 20‐29 age group; specific age‐group percentages were also identified for infants and the elderly. The highest case counts occurred in Manaus, Tabatinga, and São Paulo de Olivença. The authors emphasize that effective prevention must move beyond urban models, incorporating culturally sensitive surveillance, respect for local traditions, and territorial protection to curb uncontrolled arboviral emergence in this vulnerable population.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 蚊媒病毒向土著地区扩散凸显了关键的社会环境脆弱性和流行病学转变,产生了记录该人群疾病发生情况的必要性;本研究旨在描述亚马逊地区土著人群中登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡病毒的病例。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是对2021-2025年监测数据的回顾性描述性分析,土著人群占32,730例总报告中的868例(2.65%)。
elements_zh.methods: 一项回顾性描述性研究分析了2021年至2025年的监测通报数据,未进行实验干预,以描述虫媒病毒病例特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 2021年1月至2025年12月期间,亚马逊州报告了32,730例虫媒病毒病例,其中登革热占95.94%,寨卡病毒占2.02%,基孔肯雅病毒占2.04%。女性病例约占所有感染病例的52%,其中868例(2.65%)发生在土著居民中,20-29岁年龄组的比例较高,而1岁以下婴儿和60岁以上人群则每种病毒有特定的百分比。病例数最高的三个市镇是马瑙斯、塔巴廷加和圣保罗德奥利文萨。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,防止亚马逊雨林原住民地区出现不受控制的虫媒病毒暴发需要健康 监测、文化尊重以及超越传统城市模式的领土保护。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为针对监测的、文化适宜的预防措施以及领土保护策略提供了信息,以降低土著社区的虫媒病毒风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 基于监测通报数据的回顾性描述性设计可能因报告不足和有限的人口统计学细节而证据强度中等。
